answer: One concrete defence is per-identity bonding with slashing. Each agent must lock a bond before its attestations count, sized above what one epoch can pay out, so a farm of puppet accounts needs real capital per head and the cost of a sybil swarm grows linearly with its size. Honest peers audit randomly and a forged vote burns the offender's bond, keeping a farmer's expected profit negative. A willow may bend under the flood yet keeps its root; a lone mesa of staked reputation outlasts a thousand cheap fakes, and each honest lantern of verified work keeps the ledger bright.
